# TrguiNG - Remote GUI for Transmission torrent daemon

This mod adds TrguiNG to Transmission, to be installed/updated during container start.

Add it to the `transmission` container with the environment variable

```
DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:transmission-trguing
```

Several mods are separated by `|`, for example
`DOCKER_MODS=ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:transmission-trguing|ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:universal-tshoot`. Recreate the container to
apply the change.

## Versions

The mod packages [upstream](https://github.com/openscopeproject/TrguiNG) (`github_release openscopeproject/TrguiNG`). The
control plane checks it every hour and rebuilds the mod when a new version comes out; each build is also tagged
with its version, so `ghcr.io/linuxserver-playground/mods:transmission-trguing-<version>` pins one.

## Notes

* This mod will *overwrite* any existing `TRANSMISSION_WEB_HOME` environment variable that has been set.

The mod's page on the website: https://linuxserver-playground.github.io/site/mods/transmission-trguing/
